app.name: Diviyata Saviyak

login.title: Sign in to the system
login.passwordReset: Your new password is set. Sign in with it.
login.help: If you have no account or have forgotten your username, contact the administrator at Head Office.

errors.required: Enter both your username and your password.
errors.invalid: The username or password is wrong.
errors.wrong: The username or password is wrong. {count, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} left. After 5 wrong attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.locked: The account is locked after 5 wrong attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}, or contact the administrator.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.intro: You were given a temporary password. Set a new password of your own to continue.
changePassword.introVoluntary: Change your password. Your sessions on other computers will end.

errors.tooLong: The new password can't be longer than 128 characters.
errors.mismatch: Enter the same new password both times.
errors.sameAsCurrent: The new password must be different from the current one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your username. A 6-digit code will be sent to the email address in your account, and with it you can set a new password.
forgotPassword.noUsername: If you have forgotten your username, or your account has no email address or yours has changed, contact the administrator at Head Office.

email.subject: Diviyata Saviyak: your code to reset your password
email.heading: Reset your password
email.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your account. Enter the code below on the "Forgot your password?" page.
email.valid: This code is valid for 15 minutes only.
email.secret: Don't tell this code to anyone.
email.notYou: If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.
email.automatic: This email was sent automatically. Please don't reply to it.

code.sent: If the username is right, a code has been sent to the email address in the account. It is valid for 15 minutes.
code.label: Code from the email
code.noEmail: If no email arrives within a few minutes, look in the spam folder too. If it isn't there, check the username and ask for a new code. If it still doesn't arrive, contact the administrator at Head Office.

password.intro: The code is right. Now set your new password.

errors.tooMany: Too many requests from this computer. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.emailFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Try again in a little while, or contact the administrator at Head Office.
errors.emailOff: Resetting a password by email isn't switched on yet. For a new password, contact the administrator at Head Office.

codeErrors.required: Enter the code from the email.
codeErrors.format: The code has 6 digits. Type it as it is in the email.
codeErrors.wrong: The code is wrong. {count, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
codeErrors.tooManyTries: 5 wrong codes were entered, so this code no longer works. Ask for a new code.
codeErrors.expired: This code has expired, or a newer one was sent. Ask for a new code.

passwordErrors.tooShort: The new password must have at least 8 characters.
